description: mastodon: List an account's statuses. GET /v1/mastodon/account/statuses. Provide one of: acct, id. One page of public statuses. Pass acct, or id together with instance. max_id is the older-than cursor. An empty page costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when statuses is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.

id.description: Account id on the instance, used with instance instead of acct.

instance.description: Instance hostname. Required when id is used instead of acct.

max_id.description: Return statuses older than this id.

name: mastodon_account_statuses
